requiredScope: All earlier obligations remain in force. General CTE dependencies, recursion, multiple occurrences and hints remain open.

Rows/LocalSource.role: The single local input occurrence of a projection over one ordinary CTE.
Rows/LocalSource.structure: A checked VALUES query and an ordered explicit list of unique SQLite column identifiers.
Rows/LocalSource.boundary: The list width equals that of each operand row. The SELECT checks membership at occurrence zero, absence of joins for this role and the statement-wide expanded budget including the definition.
Rows/LocalSource.meaning: The definition supplies the row bag. An occurrence-zero column slot denotes its position in the explicit output list. CTE source names are local identifiers without external identity.
Rows/LocalSource.sql: Emit the definition before the body with an unambiguous generated CTE name. Preserve the definition's column order and lexical parameter order.

analysis: Recognize one nonrecursive CTE with an explicit column list and VALUES definition, no materialization hint, and a single projection FROM occurrence that resolves to exactly that definition. Its projection, filter, ordinal ordering, DISTINCT and bounds retain the existing SELECT rules.

External shadowing and qualified local references
